hall.desc: You're standing in a long dimly lit hallway. Doors are to the north and east. An open doorway leads into a dark room to the south.

kitchen.desc: You are standing in an old dusty kitchen lit by a spell book lying on the floor. A door is to the north.

dining room.desc: You are standing in a dining room. A long wooden table is here surrounded by chairs. Doors lie to the west and south.

garden.desc: You are standing in a well kept garden. Clearly, someone spends time working here. The garden is surrounded by smooth walls that appear impossible to climb. A door leads back into the house to the north. To the south, a gate leads into a mysterious maze.

library.desc: You are standing in a library. Cobwebs clutter the corners of the room. The windows in this room are boarded up, although, there is a fire in the hearth. Clearly, someone has been here recently.

maze entry.desc: You stand at the entrance to a twisting maze. The gate to the north leads back to the garden. Paths lead deeper into the maze.

maze path 1.desc: A narrow path with high hedges. The way west leads out, east goes deeper, and south is a shadowy dead end.

maze path 2.desc: A glint catches your eye: a sword lies here. Paths lead west and east.

maze path 3.desc: The maze twists south. The way west returns to the sword.

maze path 4.desc: A small fountain bubbles here, its waters said to heal. Paths lead north and east.

maze path 5.desc: The path splits: east goes deeper, south is a dead end, west returns to the fountain.

maze path 6.desc: The path twists and turns, with high hedges blocking your view. East and south are possible, west returns to the split.

maze path 7.desc: The path narrows. East is a dead end, south leads to the heart of the maze.

maze dead end 2.desc: A dead end. The only way out is north. A pouch of marbles lies forgotten here.

maze center.desc: You have reached the center of the maze. A fearsome minotaur stands guard here. To the south, a narrow passage leads into a cave entrance. It looks just wide enough for you to wiggle through, but the Minotaur is far too large.

cave entrance.desc: A narrow cave entrance, barely wide enough for you to squeeze through. The Minotaur would never fit. Darkness stretches ahead.
